Oren Brass — level 1

The investigator-tinker who wins fights by understanding them.

Human Intellect · HP 17/17 · Grit 2/2 · Speed 7 squares · Bulk 9/10.

Languages: Common, River Speech; spoken-only Dwarven and Harbor Cant (A Foot in Two Worlds).

Level 1 — class and purchases

Choose @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.2eae29f3c9a9ce52.JournalEntryPage.f6f13e8b96d5e485]{Intellect}. Class grants Craft 1 and Scholarship 1; 2 duplicate(s) give +2 DP, not higher ranks. Free signature: @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.b3ab9788a1d1e6e2.JournalEntryPage.81a3c26503b2049d]{Make the Connection}. Its use procedure follows; the linked card remains the complete reference:

Action: Main Action · Attribute: None — no roll

Time: One minute.

Target / range / shape: An accessible person, object or scene with evidence you can examine.

Spend one minute examining the evidence and state a question. Learn one supported fact relevant to it and a specific way to investigate further: a person to question, place to examine or test to perform, if one exists. If the evidence cannot answer your question, learn what kind of evidence is missing. No roll; obvious clues remain available to everyone. This does not reveal thoughts or invent events.

Duration: Information remains known.

Equipment / acquisition: None.

Signature limit: One reading per question until new evidence becomes available.

Fresh pool: 13 + 2 = 15 DP. All discipline purchases below occur before cards that need them.

HP: 12 + ancestry 2 + class 2 + Fortitude 0 + trait 0 + Conditioned Body 1 = 17. Capacity: 10 + 3 × Brawn (0) = 10. Granted Bulk 2 + purchased Bulk 7 = 9, so encumbrance penalty 0. Speed: ancestry 6 + Agility 0 + trait 1 = 7.

Physical resistance: 0. Other resistances: 0. Wounds and death marks: 0. Grit: 2. No HP or Grit has been spent during creation.

Starting coins and market purchases are resolved in the shopping ledger below. Card-granted equipment is not purchased again. Repeated compatible weapon/tool grants supply no duplicates.

Recipes chosen: Trail Workshop → Bound Torches and Fletched Ammunition; Make Something Useful → Travel Food and Twisted Cord; Ordinary Recipe Study → Wooden Brace and Simple Replacement Leg. All six are distinct compatible ordinary recipes. One craft tool set serves both crafting cards. The shopping ledger supplies one compatible ordinary material bundle; other ingredients still need to be obtained.

At the table

Message by Heart lets Oren preserve an exact witness statement of up to 50 words after one minute of rehearsal. Only one message is retained this way.

Anatomy of an Opening uses Knowledge in a fight; Oren chooses its optional melee-weapon grant. Make the Connection turns actual evidence into a fact and follow-up lead. Crafting and identification make discoveries useful, while Medicine supports wound care. Oren’s card grants supply tools and recipe knowledge; his shopping ledger adds ordinary ingredients, but no finished crafted supplies.

Complete learned-card checklist

These are all origin grants, purchases and the free signature; there is no equipped-card limit. Universal references are supplied separately.
